digest.component_or_area: local LLM configuration and developer gates
propositions: Local developer gates must be configured to resolve model classes to Bedrock inference profiles and execute end-to-end without failures or provider fallback
All three local gates (review-plan, review-code, verify-completion) must produce parseable verdicts with validated structured output when run against Bedrock
Prompt caching must engage on the Bedrock path, evidenced by nonzero cache_read_tokens in usage logs across multiple gate runs
Configuration must be reversible via a single environment variable without code changes, allowing developers to revert from Bedrock to Anthropic in one step
Zero direct-Anthropic provider calls must occur during Bedrock gate runs when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is unset, confirmed by provider-clean usage log tally
